tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send an email to one or more email addresses, with a subject and body. Use this for emailing someone. For posting in a team chat channel, use `post_message`. For notifying the user's own phone, use `push_message`. For texting a phone number, use `dispatch_message`.

tools.name: post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a team chat channel such as #general. Cannot send email. Use this for posting in a team chat channel. For emailing someone, use `send_message`. For notifying the user's own phone, use `push_message`. For texting a phone number, use `dispatch_message`.

tools.name: push_message
tools.description: Send a push notification to the current user's own phone. Cannot reach anyone else. Use this for notifying the user's own phone. For emailing someone, use `send_message`. For posting in a team chat channel, use `post_message`. For texting a phone number, use `dispatch_message`.

tools.name: dispatch_message
tools.description: Send an SMS text message to a phone number. Use this for texting a phone number. For emailing someone, use `send_message`. For posting in a team chat channel, use `post_message`. For notifying the user's own phone, use `push_message`.
